label: Through a wire segment
subgoals: Add the wire capacitance to the downstream load
Subtract the wire resistance times half its capacitance plus the load

label: Through a buffer
subgoals: Replace the load with the buffer's input capacitance
Subtract the buffer's intrinsic delay and its resistance times the load
Keep both the buffered and the unbuffered candidate

label: Across a branch
subgoals: Take the smaller of the two required times
Merge the sorted lists linearly to keep only non-dominated pairs
